test.query: SELECT sum(length(toValidUTF8(value))) FROM ( SELECT arrayJoin([ concat(repeat('a', 63), toString(number % 10)), concat(repeat('a', 95), toString(number % 10)), concat(repeat('a', 126), toString(number % 10)) ]) AS value FROM numbers(100000) ) FORMAT Null

SELECT sum(length(toValidUTF8(value))) FROM ( SELECT arrayJoin([ concat(repeat('é', 31), toString(number % 10), 'a'), concat(repeat('é', 47), toString(number % 10), 'a'), concat(repeat('é', 63), toString(number % 10)) ]) AS value FROM numbers(100000) ) FORMAT Null

SELECT sum(length(toValidUTF8(value))) FROM ( SELECT arrayJoin([ concat(repeat('é', 26), '中文🙂', toString(number % 10), 'a'), concat(repeat('é', 42), '中文🙂', toString(number % 10), 'a'), concat(repeat('é', 58), '中文🙂', toString(number % 10)) ]) AS value FROM numbers(100000) ) FORMAT Null
